crests.name: Ernest
crests.description: A Crest long lost to history. Occasionally stops enemy counterattacks when using a weapon.

crests.name: Macuil
crests.description: Legend has it that Saint Macuil bore this Crest. A symbol of magic and mastery of the wind. Occasionally raises Mt during magic attacks.

crests.name: Seiros
crests.description: Legend has it that Saint Seiros bore this Crest and passed it down through House Hresvelg. Occasionally raises Mt when using combat arts.

crests.name: Dominic
crests.description: House Dominic’s Crest, inherited from Dominic of the 10 Elites. Occasionally conserves uses of attack magic.

crests.name: Fraldarius
crests.description: House Fraldarius’s Crest, inherited from Fraldarius of the 10 Elites. Sometimes raises Mt when using a weapon.

crests.name: Noa
crests.description: A Crest long lost to history. Occasionally does not consume a use during magic attacks.

crests.name: Cethleann
crests.description: Legend has it that Saint Cethleann bore this Crest. A symbol of kindness and mastery of light. Sometimes raises Mt when using recovery magic.

crests.name: Daphnel
crests.description: House Daphnel and House Galatea’s Crest, inherited from Daphnel of the 10 Elites. Sometimes raises Mt when using combat arts.

crests.name: Blaiddyd
crests.description: The Faerghus royal family’s Crest, inherited from Blaiddyd of the 10 Elites. Occasionally doubles Atk and weapon uses for combat arts.

crests.name: Gloucester
crests.description: House Gloucester’s Crest, inherited from Gloucester of the 10 Elites. Occasionally raises Mt during magic attacks.

crests.name: Goneril
crests.description: House Goneril’s Crest, inherited from Goneril of the 10 Elites. Sometimes allows combat arts to prevent enemy counterattacks.

crests.name: Cichol
crests.description: Legend has it that Saint Cichol bore this Crest. A symbol of strength and the land. Sometimes lets combat arts prevent enemy counterattacks.

crests.name: Aubin
crests.description: A Crest long lost to history. Occasionally prevents enemy counterattacks when using a weapon.

crests.name: Gautier
crests.description: House Gautier’s Crest, inherited from Gautier of the 10 Elites. Occasionally raises Mt when using combat arts.

crests.name: Indech
crests.description: Legend has it that Saint Indech bore this Crest. A symbol of wisdom and water. Occasionally allows weapon attacks to strike twice.

crests.name: The Beast
crests.description: The Crest of a Hero whose identity was lost to history. Promises contempt for those who bear it. Sometimes raises Mt when using a weapon.

crests.name: Charon
crests.description: House Charon’s Crest, inherited from Charon of the 10 Elites. Occasionally raises Mt when using combat arts.

crests.name: Timotheos
crests.description: A Crest long lost to history. Occasionally does not consume a use for recovery magic.

crests.name: Riegan
crests.description: A Crest inherited from Riegan of the 10 Elites. Sometimes restores HP equal to 30% of damage dealt when using combat arts.

crests.name: Chevalier
crests.description: A Crest long lost to history. Sometimes restores HP equal to 30% of damage dealt when using Combat Arts.

crests.name: Lamine
crests.description: A Crest inherited from Lamine of the 10 Elites. Occasionally conserves uses of recovery magic.

crests.name: Flames
crests.description: The Crest of the goddess who governs the world. Occasionally restores HP equal to 30% of damage dealt. Rarely raises Mt and stops counterattacks.

crests.name: [Mystery Crest]
crests.description: It might be some kind of Crest, though it’s unclear which one…

crests.name: [Agarthan Crest]
crests.description: The Crest of Agartha. This Crest is engraved into weapons created with ancient technology.

crests.name: The Forge
crests.description: A blacksmith’s Crest. Can be attached to forged weapons.
